message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover for Tempo magazine, dated 30 MEI-5 JUNI 2016. A large red masthead reads "TEMPO" across the top. Below it, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in smaller red letters.

The central scene depicts a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants sitting on an orange plastic stool with his back to the viewer. He is painting a portrait on a canvas resting on a wooden easel. The canvas features a large, grey-scale, smiling face of a man with a mustache.

To the left, a man with a mustache, dressed in a grey short-sleeved uniform and dark trousers, sits on a matching orange stool, posing for the painter. He rests his hands on his lap and looks toward the artist.

Bold black text on the left reads "GADUH DI MARKAS POLISI," followed by smaller text regarding "Jokowi," "Badrodin Haiti," "PDI Perjuangan," and "Budi Gunawan." Top headlines include "DI BALIK KENAIKAN HARGA BAWANG" and "SIAPA INGIN BELI SUKHOI." A barcode and pricing information are located in the bottom-left corner.
